breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained conflicting instructions, specifying both 'Explicit forward Euler' and 'Strang splitting' as the numerical method. The ground truth correctly removed the 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction, as the detailed steps describe Strang splitting. The agent failed to resolve this conflict and instead incorrectly combined the two methods, stating 'Implement Strang splitting time integration with explicit forward Euler', which is a nonsensical instruction that repeats the user's error.
